rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist as S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one relationship)
rationale: S_N acts as a join key to Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N with 100% coverage on this table. Referential integrity must be enforced before join operations.

rule: S_N must be unique across all records (no duplicates allowed)
rationale: Column is described as a near-unique identifier with 1 repeated value ('3' appears twice). For a one-to-one join key, duplicates indicate data entry errors.

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits (1000-9999)
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers ranging from 1001-1028. Stored as int64 but intended as string to preserve character-based representation.

rule: Account_No must be unique across all records
rationale: 28 distinct values observed across 30 records with duplicates (1001 and 1010 each appear twice). Account numbers should uniquely identify accounts.

rule: Full_Name should be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles: bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Observed lowercase entries ('junrong', 'irfan') and mixed-case entries ('Lee yixuan', 'Hui Min tan') that require standardization. Malay/Indian patronymic particles should remain lowercase.

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must not contain double spaces (consecutive whitespace characters)
rationale: Evidence shows 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy' contains double-spacing that requires normalization to single spaces.

rule: ID must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one prefix letter (S, T, F, G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one checksum letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow the standard 9-character format (e.g., S8403757E). One record uses incompatible 7-character format 'S123456' missing checksum and final digit.

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: Column has 1 NULL value (3.3% of records). Join date is a mandatory business field for account creation tracking.

rule: JoinDate must be a parseable datetime string
rationale: One unparseable value '2025-13-01' contains invalid month 13. Column is stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns].

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: Join date is a historical field. Sample contains future date '2027-01-15' which is invalid for an account creation timestamp.

rule: LastLogin must be a parseable datetime string
rationale: Column is stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns]. Validation ensures all values conform to expected datetime format before conversion.

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin (account creation precedes last activity)
rationale: Logical temporal constraint: users cannot log in before joining. Sample shows S_N 20 with JoinDate '2020-11-02' but LastLogin '2019-01-01' (impossible).

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of the valid subscription tiers
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed valid values. No other subscription types should be permitted.

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: Column has 2 NULL values (6.7% of records). While Free subscriptions might have no fee, the data quality report indicates these require clarification for data completeness.

rule: SubscriptionFee must be numeric (parseable as float)
rationale: Column stored as string but intended as float64. Contains text value 'free' which cannot be parsed as numeric and requires standardization to 0.0 or NULL.

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel value '99999' indicating missing/unknown data
rationale: Value '99999' appears as statistical outlier significantly higher than next highest value (961.14), suggesting sentinel coding for missing data.

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or NULL
rationale: Business logic: Free subscriptions should not incur charges. Sample shows S_N 9 with Subscription_Type='Free' but SubscriptionFee='917.46', indicating data inconsistency.

check_params.logic: row['Subscription_Type'] == 'Free' and pd.notna(row['SubscriptionFee']) and pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') != 0

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Column intended as bool but stored as string with heterogeneous representations. Must be one of the observed valid values before standardization to True/False.

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel value 99999.0 indicating missing/invalid data
rationale: Value 99999.0 exceeds statistical upper bound (Q3 + 1.5×IQR = 1525.07) and appears sentinel-coded for missing or invalid balance data.

rule: AccountBalance must not be negative (unless overdrafts are explicitly permitted)
rationale: Account balances are inherently non-negative quantities. Value -150.5 is the sole negative entry and may represent a data entry error or overdraft requiring verification.

rule: PreferredLanguage must be a valid language option
rationale: Categorical field with 5 distinct observed values representing Singapore's official languages and common foreign languages. No other values permitted.

rule: Device must be a valid device type
rationale: Categorical field classifying user access device. Only three valid categories observed across all records.

rule: OS must be a canonical operating system name (Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS)
rationale: Evidence shows casing inconsistencies: 'android', 'LINUX', 'IOS', 'macOs' instead of canonical forms. Must standardize to official brand spellings.

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Based on FeedbackScore1 max of 5.0 and statistical outlier analysis, the valid domain appears to be 1-5. Value 7.3 exceeds this range and is likely invalid.

rule: FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel value 7.3 indicating missing/invalid data
rationale: Value 7.3 is a statistical outlier exceeding Q3 + 1.5×IQR (6.945) and appears sentinel-coded, particularly given the 1-5 range of the similar FeedbackScore1 column.

rule: FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 must be consistent (nearly duplicate columns should match)
rationale: Column facts indicate 81.25% value resemblance suggesting near-duplication. Large discrepancies (e.g., 7.3 vs 2.65 in S_N 9) indicate data quality issues.

rule: Full_Name must be consistent with Cust_Bio_dirty.Name (accounting for case differences and name particles)
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires name consistency. Sample discrepancies observed: 'Danish' vs 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin', 'junrong' vs 'Lim Jun Rong'.

check_params.semantic_check: Full_Name should match Name (case-insensitive, allowing for inclusion/exclusion of patronymic particles like Bin/Binte/s/o/d/o)

rule: ID must exactly match Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No for the same S_N
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires identifier consistency. Sample shows S_N 16 has ID='S8421753X' but Cust_Bio_dirty has 'S8421753J' (checksum mismatch).

check_params.semantic_check: ID must exactly match ID_No character-for-character
